title: TCG: Obsidian Flames
description: Charizard returns! Test your knowledge of Obsidian Flames!

questions.question: Which Pokémon's Tera ex card is the iconic chase card of the set?
questions.explanation: Charizard ex, with its Tera Darkness typing, is the defining card of Obsidian Flames.

questions.question: Charizard ex from Obsidian Flames is a Darkness-type due to its Tera typing.
questions.explanation: Despite being a Fire Pokémon, the Tera-form Charizard ex is a Darkness-type card.

questions.question: Which Paradox Pokémon is featured as ex in Obsidian Flames?

options.text: Both A and B and others

questions.explanation: Obsidian Flames features multiple ancient and future Paradox Pokémon ex including Roaring Moon and Iron Hands.

questions.question: Pidgeot ex from Obsidian Flames has an ability that lets you search your deck.
questions.explanation: Pidgeot ex's Quick Search ability lets you grab any card from your deck once per turn.

questions.question: Which Trainer card featuring Penny became popular from this set?
questions.explanation: Penny Supporter card lets you scoop your Benched Pokémon back into your hand.

questions.question: How many cards are in the Obsidian Flames set?
questions.explanation: Obsidian Flames has 230 cards including secret rares.

questions.question: Tyranitar ex is a featured Pokémon in Obsidian Flames.
questions.explanation: Tyranitar ex appears as a Darkness-type ex in the set.

questions.question: What deck archetype gained dominance because of Charizard ex from this set?
questions.explanation: The Charizard ex / Pidgeot ex deck became a top-tier Standard archetype for over a year.

questions.question: Obsidian Flames is the third main SV expansion.
questions.explanation: It followed Scarlet & Violet base and Paldea Evolved as the third major SV set.
